mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DBF_COMMIT_LOG ( DB_CONFIG_ID, COMMIT_TITLE, COMMIT_CONTENT, USER_ID, COMMIT_CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{dbConfigId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{commitTitle,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{commitContent,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{commitCreatedAt,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

INSERT INTO DBF_COMMIT_TARGET ( COMMIT_LOG_ID, DB_CONFIG_ID, OBJECT_TYPE, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_COMMENT, CHANGE_TYPE ) SELECT #{commitLogId}, DB_CONFIG_ID, OBJECT_TYPE, OBJECT_NAME, OBJECT_COMMENT, CHANGE_TYPE FROM DBF_WORK_TARGET WHERE DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId}

INSERT INTO DBF_COMMIT_COMPONENT ( COMMIT_TARGET_ID, COMPONENT_TYPE, COMPONENT_NAME, COMPONENT_COMMENT, CHANGE_TYPE ) SELECT CT.COMMIT_TARGET_ID, WC.COMPONENT_TYPE, WC.COMPONENT_NAME, WC.COMPONENT_COMMENT, WC.CHANGE_TYPE FROM DBF_WORK_COMPONENT WC JOIN DBF_WORK_TARGET WT ON WC.WORK_TARGET_ID = WT.WORK_TARGET_ID JOIN DBF_COMMIT_TARGET CT ON CT.COMMIT_LOG_ID = #{commitLogId} AND CT.DB_CONFIG_ID = WT.DB_CONFIG_ID AND CT.OBJECT_TYPE = WT.OBJECT_TYPE AND CT.OBJECT_NAME = WT.OBJECT_NAME WHERE WT.DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId}

INSERT INTO DBF_COMMIT_CHANGE ( COMMIT_COMPONENT_ID, CHANGE_COLUMN, BEFORE_VALUE, AFTER_VALUE ) SELECT CC.COMMIT_COMPONENT_ID, WCH.CHANGE_COLUMN, WCH.BEFORE_VALUE, WCH.AFTER_VALUE FROM DBF_WORK_CHANGE WCH JOIN DBF_WORK_COMPONENT WC ON WCH.WORK_COMPONENT_ID = WC.WORK_COMPONENT_ID JOIN DBF_WORK_TARGET WT ON WC.WORK_TARGET_ID = WT.WORK_TARGET_ID JOIN DBF_COMMIT_TARGET CT ON CT.COMMIT_LOG_ID = #{commitLogId} AND CT.DB_CONFIG_ID = WT.DB_CONFIG_ID AND CT.OBJECT_TYPE = WT.OBJECT_TYPE AND CT.OBJECT_NAME = WT.OBJECT_NAME JOIN DBF_COMMIT_COMPONENT CC ON CC.COMMIT_TARGET_ID = CT.COMMIT_TARGET_ID AND CC.COMPONENT_TYPE = WC.COMPONENT_TYPE AND CC.COMPONENT_NAME = WC.COMPONENT_NAME WHERE WT.DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM DBF_WORK_CHANGE WHERE WORK_COMPONENT_ID IN (SELECT WC.WORK_COMPONENT_ID FROM DBF_WORK_COMPONENT WC INNER JOIN DBF_WORK_TARGET WT ON WC.WORK_TARGET_ID = WT.WORK_TARGET_ID WHERE WT.DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId})
DELETE FROM DBF_WORK_COMPONENT WHERE WORK_TARGET_ID IN (SELECT WORK_TARGET_ID FROM DBF_WORK_TARGET WHERE DB_CONFIG_ID = #{dbConfigId})
